instruction: Cinematic wide shot of a dance studio with dark walls and a wooden floor. In the center, the man in the brown long-sleeve shirt (R1) is on all fours, supporting the woman in the yellow long-sleeve shirt (R2) who arches her back backward over him, reaching one arm down. To the left, the man in the brown shirt and black pants (R3) is on all fours, supporting the woman with the ponytail in a yellow shirt (R4) who arches backward over his back. On the right, a bystander pair of dancers in yellow and brown shirts perform a similar back-bend pose. Dim ambient light with a bright spotlight from the upper right illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
